corrections.why: Forest Fire Lookout, Idaho Fire Lookouts and the Forest Service list give 5,981 ft (about 1,823 m). Only the NHLR detail page gives 5,890 ft (1,795 m). Editor to confirm which figure to keep.

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1968 date is the current tower. The 1920s cabin, the 1932 L-4 cab and the 1934 L-6 patrol tower were earlier structures on the same site.
Rental program began in 1995. Forest Fire Lookout and Idaho Fire Lookouts say it is no longer rented; the Forest Service list still marks it Rental. The story reports both.

notes_for_editor: Elevation conflict: NHLR says 5,890 ft; three other sources say 5,981 ft. Correction proposed, editor to confirm. The 1968 date is the current structure; earlier lookouts from the 1920s, 1932 and 1934 are noted but the 1920s date is only a decade. Only two staff names are on record (1974, 1977). Rental status is disputed (Forest Service list vs two web sources). The Hike-In Emergency tag is read from the Idaho Fire Lookouts header. No height_m in the record; sources give a 10-ft tower. Post dated October 2, 2025.
